faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XF 5.0 V8 use?
faqLeft.a: The XF 5.0 V8 uses the AJ133 engine family, a 5.0-litre V8 petrol unit fitted from around 2011 to 2015 in the X250 generation. The naturally aspirated version is the AJ133, while the supercharged version (XFR) is the AJ133S.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XF 5.0 V8 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500 for the naturally aspirated AJ133, and from £5,500 for the supercharged AJ133S (XFR). Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my XF 5.0 V8?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the AJ133 or AJ133S before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ133 XF 5.0 V8 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guides, and water pump as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ133S XFR engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The AJ133S shares the same architecture and timing chain pattern as the naturally aspirated AJ133, and we service it to the same standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used XF 5.0 V8 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XF 5.0 V8 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XF 5.0 V8 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XF 5.0 V8 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
